This page lists selected publications together with a fuller chronological record of journal articles. For working papers and older versions, see the [IDEAS/RePEc author page](http://ideas.repec.org/f/pbr294.html) or the [CV (PDF)](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/pwlra56p5qgnsfm3jgwml/cv_short.pdf?rlkey=3xcc5ol8gobuhwgbkxdwrzdqi&dl=0).

## Selected Publications

### Crime, Policing, and Neighbourhoods

- [Crime prevention through private actors: Evidence from a policy change at a large UK supermarket chain](https://doi.org/10.1111/obes.70020) (with Wednesday Croft). Forthcoming in *Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics*.
- [Expected Returns to Crime and Crime Location](https://doi.org/10.1257/app.20220585) (with [Arnaud Chevalier][arnaud-chevalier] and [Tanya Wilson][tanya-wilson]). *American Economic Journal: Applied Economics* 16(4), 2024, 144-160.
- [Racial Disparities in Civilian Response to Police Use of Force: Evidence from London](https://doi.org/10.1093/bjc/azae037). *British Journal of Criminology* 65(1), 2025, 182-201.

### Labour Markets and Worker Adjustment

- [Mass layoffs and voting behaviour: Evidence from the UK](https://doi.org/10.1111/bjir.12749) (with [Wessel Vermeulen][wessel-vermeulen]). *British Journal of Industrial Relations* 61(4), 2023, 922-950.
- [Worker adjustment to unexpected occupational risk: Evidence from COVID-19](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.euroecorev.2022.104325) (with [Barbara Eberth][barbara-eberth] and [John Wildman][john-wildman]). *European Economic Review* 150, 2022, 104325.
- [Do higher education strikes affect university outcomes? Evidence from pension disputes in UK universities](https://doi.org/10.1111/irel.12392) (with [Barbara Eberth][barbara-eberth]). *Industrial Relations* 65(1), 2026, 45-63.

### Urban Change and Local Economies

- [Austerity, welfare cuts and hate crime: Evidence from the UK's Age of Austerity](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jue.2022.103439) (with Kerry Bray and [John Wildman][john-wildman]). *Journal of Urban Economics* 141, 2024, 103439.
- [Housing subsidies and property prices: Evidence from England](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.regsciurbeco.2018.06.002) (with Stephen McDonald). *Regional Science and Urban Economics* 80, 2020, 103374.
